kind: fresh current-run read-only mobile material/hierarchy audit

excluded_from_curated_evidence.reason: new-task confirmation toast partially covered the final row; same list recaptured quietly in09, original kept

findings.finding: Light form property container and ordinary input share near-identical grey-purple depth; comparatively dark outlines carry most separation.
findings.recommendation: Raise input fill above the property pane, keep the property pane recessed, and harmonize standard border and focus without reducing essential control boundary contrast.

findings.finding: Filter module, project bands and continuous task sheet are expressed as similar flat fills. Main content has no subtle surface edge or contact depth; grey project bands compete with task titles.
findings.recommendation: Give the continuous task sheet a clearer material against the canvas; quiet project bands with typographic separation; keep toolbar secondary and avoid changing into a card per task.

findings.finding: Settings preferences and preview gallery are legible, but repeated flat panels and strong inactive theme outlines make different levels read with similar weight.
findings.recommendation: Unify preference, theme preview and selected-state material tokens; preserve native radio identity and distinguish actual selected theme from default boundaries.

findings.finding: Three-row numeric entry design works and keeps labels visible; its fill and surrounding review blocks are similar flat surfaces.
findings.recommendation: Carry the new panel material through compact action rows and review sheet, retaining data meanings and drilldown structure.

healthy_steps.health: Menu visibly escapes the task surface, has a clear float shadow and a separated destructive row; retain geometry and keyboard path.
Centered modal, dim/blur backdrop, visible autofocus name and fixed footer all have clear task focus; preserve responsive form and safe footer geometry.
Stable Add task and bottom four-view navigation remain visible; long Chinese task text and metadata wrap without horizontal overflow.

limits: Only Iris theme mobile light/dark was operated; not a four-palette or desktop audit.
Visible screenshot inspection plus DOM/CSS surface metadata, not a WCAG contrast or screen-reader certification.
Theme controls and task forms operated in new browser data only; no existing user data or production source was changed.
Initial HTTP navigation bound source; not one fetch per screenshot.
